verdict.rationale: Superhuman's engineering blog claims the app 'works perfectly offline' and even on bad connections, and its search write-up states search shouldn't require a network connection, which covers offline reading and search. Composing offline and syncing changes on reconnect are only implied by the general offline claim, not explicitly documented. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of offline composing/sending queue, documented sync-on-reconnect behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration of offline use.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can read, search, and write email offline, with changes syncing when I reconnect

citations.quote: Superhuman gives you a new way to work with Gmail. It works perfectly offline. It works even when online, and your internet connection is terrible.
Available: The search shouldn't require a network connection to function.
